newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS confirms Alcan ratings, stable outlook.
newsitem.headline: CBRS confirms Alcan ratings, stable outlook.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service Inc said on Monday that it confirmed the ratings of Alcan Aluminium Ltd, with a stable rating outlook for 1997.

CBRS said it confirmed Alcan's commercial paper at A-1, its long-term debt at A(Low) and preferred shares at P-2(Low). All of the company's fixed-income securities continued to maintain their stable rating outlook, the rating agency said.
The assigned ratings reflected the good quality credit risk attached to Alcan's outstanding securities, CBRS said after analyzing the company's 1996 financial results.

CBRS said Alcan's strong financial profile would allow it to finance adequately any future expansions in selected segments of the aluminum industry without any discernible impact on existing credit quality.
